mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages ( conversation_id, sequence_number, role, content, model_name, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{sequenceNumber}, #{role}, #{content}, #{modelName}, 'COMPLETED', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, sequence_number, role, content, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY sequence_number ASC

SELECT recent.message_id, recent.conversation_id, recent.sequence_number, recent.role, recent.content, recent.created_at FROM ( SELECT message_id, conversation_id, sequence_number, role, content, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY sequence_number DESC LIMIT 20 ) recent ORDER BY recent.sequence_number ASC
SELECT content FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND role = 'USER' AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY sequence_number DESC LIMIT 1
